dejavu-fonts-ttf 2.37.3 (tarball integrity sha512-f1hd7jJbeQa1VWcw+K2KrTXS50zTMaHpVC4XIKJpNcDeYR5ajMtj/iLlQDYNvLOKamUB3ARVVCf79lNwNVztSQ==),
the same files served at https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dejavu-fonts-ttf@2.37.3/ttf/. Their license is LICENSE-font.txt.
text-regular.js and text-bold.js carry the same bytes in base64, so a page that may load scripts but not fetch files can
use them; they are generated by the phase 6 check embed-data.js and checked against SHA256SUMS.
